evidence.detail: shadow API (CWE-668; OWASP API8:2023 scope): the crawl discovered a LIVE JSON endpoint the supplied spec does not declare — GET /api/v2/internal/telemetry answered HTTP 200 with content-type application/json. Undocumented surface is unreviewed attack surface: no spec governance, no deprecation path,

zombie API — deprecated but alive (CWE-1104; OWASP API8:2023 'outdated API versions'): the spec DECLARES GET /api/v1/users deprecated:true, yet the live endpoint still answers HTTP 200. Deprecated versions stop receiving security fixes while remaining fully reachable.

zombie API — dead declaration (spec drift): the spec declares GET /api/v2/ghost but the live endpoint answers HTTP 404. The spec misleads every consumer built on it (clients, gateways, reviewers) — the declaration is a lie about the surface.
